Container.Name: Direct-Xfer
Container.Overview: Direct file sharing and receiving over HTTP or HTTPS, with an administrator interface, reception links, collaboration links, direct images, and a companion PWA.

Config.Name: Host files (read-only)
Config.Description: Host filesystem exposed read-only; ordinary shares reference it directly while image links make managed copies.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent settings, generated password, links, audit log, and metadata.

Config.Name: Images
Config.Description: Managed Full, Mini and Micro image copies plus revoked-image history previews.

Config.Name: Received files
Config.Description: Writable destination for files received through upload and collaboration links.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal application port; keep equal to the WebUI container port.

Config.Name: LOCAL_IP
Config.Description: Optional LAN address shown by Direct-Xfer when Docker bridge auto-detection is insufficient.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to 1 when Direct-Xfer is behind a trusted reverse proxy.
